thread:
Maria Torres: Quick design review — new mock for SLO alert suppression + notification preview is up: https://figma.redwood/s/abcd1234. Main questions: 1) Preview placement (inline vs. flyout), 2) suppression rule UX (recurring windows, ad-hoc snooze), 3) keyboard/ARIA for channel multiselect. Can folks glance before 3pm?

Kevin Zhang: looked — nice direction. main worry: inline preview is very tall, it pushes threshold controls below fold. propose collapsed preview (chevron) with a compact sample by default. :eyes:

Shilpa Rao: +1 on collapsed. impl note: current live streaming preview hooks into our websocket and re-renders per token — expensive. recommend static sample payload + toggled live stream ("Live preview") to avoid perf regressions. also thumbs up for debounce on channel typeahead.

Maria Torres: good call. so default: compact sample + "open live preview" button. Also want keyboard nav: tab into preview, arrow to sample items, esc to close.

design-bot: Accessibility scan (automated): 2 issues found — CTA orange (#ff8a2b) fails AA contrast on secondary text; suppression modal focus trap missing for screen readers. See report: https://ci.redwood/a11y/RE123

Alex Kim: Regarding thresholds: we should display "effective alerting window" and show sample alert frequency for the chosen threshold (e.g., ">0.5% errors over 30m ≈ 3 alerts/day for current traffic"). Users are confusing percentage vs absolute counts. Also prefer showing both rolling and calendar-aligned suppression previews.

Oliver Park: Copy tweak: current label "Temporarily mute" is ambiguous. Suggest: "Temporarily silence notifications for selected channels". Also add microcopy under suppression timepicker: "Notifications will be paused only for channels selected below."

Kevin Zhang: small ux nit — channel chips should show channel avatar + truncated name, and an explicit delete (x) visible on hover. Avoid just plain text rows.

Shilpa Rao: implementation detail: multiselect with avatars ok, but we need aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Remove channel #oncall\"`. Also for keyboard users, make chips focusable and removable with Backspace/Delete. Example snippet: `<button aria-label=\"Remove channel #oncall\">×</button>`

Maria Torres: another flow question — suppression presets (work-hours, nights, weekend) — should they be first-class or a dropdown? I lean presets visible as pill shortcuts + custom rule below.

Alex Kim: presets are nice. but make clear which presets apply across timezone (use account timezone by default) and show the UTC range on hover. Ops will ask.

Shilpa Rao: I'll prototype the collapsed-preview + static sample today, and add keyboard focus states. Planning a small PR for the channel chips + aria changes.

Kevin Zhang: one last accessibility nit — ensure contrast for chip text in selected state (WCAG AA). Also keep 3-digit precision trimmed for compact threshold labels (e.g., 0.325% -> 0.33%).

Maria Torres: perfect. I'll update the figma with collapsed preview, new copy, and presets as pills. tagging @Shilpa and @Kevin for follow-up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

design-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Sync after PR" at 17:00 today.
